# VoiceExecAI

> A voice assistant for sales reps. You speak (or type) a command in your web browser and VoiceExecAI drafts and sends an email from your connected Microsoft Outlook account, books an Outlook meeting, creates a follow-up task, or drafts a proposal document.

- It does not answer or make phone calls. It acts only when you give it a command.
- Plans: paid only (no free plan, no free trial). Pro $49/month. Enterprise $999/month, set up by email.
- Special pricing for new members: 50% off your first 3 months. We may end or change this offer at any time.
- Business: Richard Ryan LLC, 555 5th Avenue #1910, Des Moines, Iowa 50309. Contact: richy@voiceexecai.com
